recentItems.title: Luck of the Draw: The Making of Roulette "Time Passing" Trailer
recentItems.description: "Time Passing" - With the independent feature film "Roulette" nearing completion, now's the time to see how it came to life.  With 15 episodes clocking in at over 110 minutes, and more to come, "Luck of the Draw: The Making of 'Roulette'" is a behind the scenes series you can't miss.  Over 2 years in the making, "LotD" is funny, enlightening, and heartbreaking, capturing the making of a movie and the achievement of a dream.  Every day, every story, this is Luck of the Draw.

recentItems.title: Luck of the Draw: The Making of "Roulette" Part 16
recentItems.description: Try, Try Again: The reshoot process continues, as the cast and crew of Roulette flock to Kings Contrivance restaurant for Ethan Meyer's Luck of the Draw Part 16: Try, Try Again.  Two scenes featuring actors Mike Baldwin, Will Haza, Michelle Murad, & Troy Russell, require extras, and who better to fill the background than a collection of regional filmmakers?  Featuring a Whos Who of Mid-Atlantic creative professionals, Luck of the Draw and Roulette approach the end of their respective journeys.

recentItems.title: Luck of the Draw: The Making of "Roulette" Part 15
recentItems.description: Color Correction: One of the largest jobs in the post production process is color correction.  Dylan Lee & Director Erik Kristopher Myers demonstrate the color palettes of the main characters and how Roulette's image evolves between shooting and the big screen in Part 15 of Ethan Meyer's Luck of the Draw: The Making of "Roulette."

recentItems.title: Luck of the Draw: The Making of "Roulette" Part 14
recentItems.description: "Music Notes" - With the feature film "Roulette" in post-production, the job of the composer begins.  In Part 14 of Etypical Productions' series "Luck of the Draw: The Making of 'Roulette," Composer Dan Schepleng reveals what it takes to score the film, and dives into the character themes, music creation, and the invaluable input of Ludwig van Beethoven.

recentItems.title: Luck of the Draw: The Making of "Roulette" Part 13
recentItems.description: "The Solution" - The producers of Roulette were faced with a difficult decision in "The Situation," Part 12 of Luck of the Draw, Etypical Productions' web series.  In Part 13, "The Solution", a remedy is found for what ails the film: a new actress, Michelle Murad, to play the character of Zoe Clarke.  The film goes backwards, from post production to production, reshooting scenes that have been completed for over a year.  Whats the attitude of the cast and crew, not to mention the effect of a new actor on set?  "The Solution" features interviews with Director Erik Kristopher Myers, Producers Brian Andress and Laura Myers, Director of Photography Jamie Bender, Actors Mike Baldwin and Will Haza, and the new Zoe herself.

recentItems.title: Luck of the Draw: The Making of "Roulette" Part 12
recentItems.description: "The Situation" - A contractual mishap causes all work on the feature film "Roulette" to screech to a halt.  The production team is faced with a difficult decision, and the fate of the movie hangs in the balance. Part 12 of Etypical Productions' series "Luck of the Draw: The Making of 'Roulette."

recentItems.title: Luck of the Draw: The Making of "Roulette" Part 11
recentItems.description: "Where's the Movie?" - That's the question on everyone's mind in Part 11 of Etypical Productions behind the scenes series "Luck of the Draw."  Director Erik Kristopher Myers, Executive Producer Laura Myers, Producer Brian Andress, Composer Dan Schepleng, Post Production Audio Adam White, and actress Amy Freedman talk about the post production process on "Roulette," and what goes into making a movie, after making a movie.

recentItems.title: Luck of the Draw: The Making of "Roulette" Part 10
recentItems.description: "Movietime" - Part 10 of Etypical Productions' series, "Luck of the Draw: The Making of 'Roulette." Part 10 reveals the moment that the cast and crew have been waiting for.  After the screening of the film in Part 9, "Appe-teaser," Director Erik Kristopher Myers, D.P. Jamie Bender, E.P. Laura Myers, and A.P. Brian Andress discuss the first cut of the film "Roulette."  Also, the very first peek at the movie, right here on Luck of the Draw.  For a higher definition video, visit ethanmeyer.com or subscribe to the podcast on iTunes.

recentItems.title: Luck of the Draw: The Making of "Roulette" Part 9
recentItems.description: "Appe-teaser" - Part 9 of Etypical Productions' series, "Luck of the Draw: The Making of 'Roulette."  Part 9 steps into post-production with the film, taking a look at the editing process and then the producers sit down to watch the first cut of the film.  Included is an exclusive first look of the film "Roulette."  More to come in Part 10 of "Luck of the Draw."

recentItems.title: Luck of the Draw: The Making of "Roulette" Part 8
recentItems.description: "Wrap Party Dos" - Part 8 of Etypical Productions' series, "Luck of the Draw: The Making of 'Roulette." Part 8 competes "Roulette's" Wrap Party, celebrating the completion of principal photography. "Duo" features dancing, drinks, and memories of a certain important crew member, Sol Rosenberg.  When the party ends, "Roulette" moves on into post-production.  As does "Luck of the Draw."

recentItems.title: Luck of the Draw: The Making of "Roulette" Part 7
recentItems.description: "Wrap Party Uno" - Part 7 of Etypical Productions' series, "Luck of the Draw: The Making of 'Roulette." Part 7 takes a look at "Roulette's" Wrap Party, celebrating the completion of principal photography.  "Uno" features the opening speech by the "Core Five," a.k.a. Director Erik Kristopher Myers, D.R. Jamie Bender, A.D./A.P. Brian Andress, Exect Producer Laura Myers, and lead actor/A.P. Mike Baldwin, as well as thoughts from various cast & crew.  More from the wrap party in LOTD: Part 8, "Wrap Party Dos."

recentItems.title: Luck of the Draw: The Making of "Roulette" Part 6
recentItems.description: "Controlled Burn" - Part 6 of Etypical Productions' series, "Luck of the Draw: The Making of 'Roulette."  Part 6 looks at the beginning of the "Suicide Room" sequence: over twenty pages of filming in 4 nights.  An immense task on any day, the cast and crew must also battle the location, the equipment, and race against the sun.
